website_summary.name: Social Media Profile Viewer
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and modern Instagram-like profile page with a grid layout of posts, interactive buttons, and user details.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a well-organized layout with a header containing the site title ("Instagram Clone"), navigation icons, and a user profile icon. Below the header, there's a sidebar displaying the user's avatar, username, bio, location, website link, join date, follower count, and a list of suggested users. The main content area showcases a grid of images representing the user's posts, some marked as videos or albums. Each post includes interaction icons for likes and comments, which appear when hovering over the image. The overall design uses a light theme with soft colors and rounded edges, creating a visually appealing and user-friendly interface.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to view their profile details, including posts, saved items, and tagged content. Users can edit their profile by clicking the "Edit Profile" button. They can also navigate through different sections using tabs such as Posts, Saved, and Tagged. The website supports interaction with posts via liking and commenting, indicated by icons that appear on hover. Additionally, users can explore suggested profiles and follow them directly from the sidebar.
